searchText: Do you plan to move the deposit address to the tests' parameter? Ar maybe agree that all future testnets to have the same address? I think testing team is working on some tests for deposit address. I think its generally a bad idea to assume that the deposit address is always the same. As this would probably introduce some clients to just hardcode it, and that could also lead to some breaking changes down the line. There is similar issue with chain id. evmone happily passes all EEST tests with chain id and deposit contract hardcoded 🙂 Ideally, we'd: 1. Generate test releases per chain. 2. Add: i. A new endpoint to execution layer clients that reports the client's current config, ii. A pre-defined config spec per chain (to the Fork Meta EIP?). iii. Tests that ensure they match. Personally, I'd like to have both. But 1. adds quite a lot of overhead (all CI test infra and monitoring gets duplicated per testnet). But I'm not sure whether this should be the focus before pectra mainnet, as we're all outta testnets. Now, we should focus on the mainnet config. Plz correct me if I'm wrong. Test addresses already dynamic with pre.sender_eoa What we are discussing in <#1344794120731758654> will likely address 2.i - https://hackmd.io/@shemnon/eth_config#Test-Cases - If there are any other configs that have broken a devnet or testnet let me know what we need to add.
